verdict.rationale: YYLO's integration scripts can bring GitHub issues or Slack messages into its kanban and post completed responses back to the source thread. Its parallel and run-until-completion runners then execute open kanban tasks with coding agents. So an issue can become agent work, but only through a separate integration-script import step rather than direct assignment from the ticket, and the support rests on one thin docs line. Missing for 10: direct per-issue assignment to an agent, documentation of the issue-to-task mapping and supported trackers beyond GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
